name: Moonbrook Schoolhouse
summary: Standing in the northwestern corner of Moonbrook, the Schoolhouse is a prominent building resembling a town hall with a small graveyard behind it. Originally erected to educate local children under headmaster Stalvan Mistmantle, it now stands derelict amidst the Defias occupation of Westfall.

sections.title: A Beacon Fallen into Shadow
sections.body: Before Moonbrook fell to ruin and bandits, the community invested in the education of its youth by raising this grand schoolhouse. After Stalvan Mistmantle began tutoring local children, the mayor commissioned him to run a school. In those brighter days, the hall bustled with students rather than thieves, standing as proof of Moonbrook's former prosperity. Now, the schoolhouse lies abandoned to the elements and infested with outlaws, while the weathered headstones of its rear cemetery silently oversee Westfall's steady decay.

sections.title: Secrets in the Floorboards
sections.body: Though long abandoned by scholars, the schoolhouse holds the beginning of a grim mystery. An old footlocker left behind on the main floor contains an unsent letter describing Stalvan's arrival in Moonbrook, his tutoring of local children, and the mayor's commission to build a new schoolhouse. A separate letter later found in Goldshire explains that regional troubles forced him to leave his post and seek work as a private tutor.

faq.q: What was this building originally used for?
faq.answer: It served as Moonbrook's schoolhouse, constructed specifically to provide local children with a formal education. Its spacious design, resembling a town hall, reflects the ambition and pride the township held before its fall.
Stalvan Mistmantle was a learned scholar who became the schoolhouse's headmaster. Investigators can follow the letters he left behind to learn more about his career.

faq.q: Why is the schoolhouse abandoned now?
faq.answer: When Moonbrook collapsed under economic strife and the Defias Brotherhood took over southern Westfall, the town's civic institutions collapsed. The schoolhouse was abandoned along with the rest of the town and is now overrun by bandits.

faq.q: What can be found inside the schoolhouse today?
faq.answer: Alliance investigators tracking Stalvan Mistmantle can find an old, dusty footlocker on the ground floor containing an unsent letter.

angles.text: The derelict schoolhouse serves as a stark reminder of how far Westfall has fallen from the Crown's protection, turning centers of learning into hideouts for outlaws.
